name: Imperial Hotel Gold Coast
description: Imperial Hotel Gold Coast is a luxury hotel at 94 Sea World Drive, Main Beach, about 100 m from the surf beach and next to the Marina Mirage shopping centre. It offers lagoon and balcony rooms and a range of suites, a calm base on the northern Gold Coast.

rooms.name: Superior Room
rooms.description: Elegant room with balcony or lagoon views and free WiFi.

rooms.name: Lagoon Room
rooms.description: Room with direct access to the lagoon-style pool area.

rooms.name: Superior Suite
rooms.description: Spacious suite with separate living area.

name: JW Marriott Gold Coast Resort & Spa
description: JW Marriott Gold Coast Resort & Spa is a luxury beachside resort in Surfers Paradise, with a spa, pools and several restaurants. A relaxing base for adults and families who want resort comfort on the Gold Coast, within a drive of the theme parks.

rooms.name: Deluxe Room
rooms.description: Comfortable room with premium bedding and free WiFi.

rooms.name: Ocean View Room
rooms.description: Room with balcony and ocean views.

rooms.name: Suite
rooms.description: Spacious suite with separate living area.

name: Mantra at Sharks
description: Mantra at Sharks is a contemporary 120-room hotel in the Gold Coast Health and Knowledge Precinct in Southport, with a free fitness centre and the Aviary Rooftop Bar. A practical, good-value base for families and groups, closer to Wet'n'Wild than the beachfront hotels.

rooms.name: Studio Room
rooms.description: Modern room with queen bed, kitchenette and free WiFi.

rooms.name: One Bedroom Suite
rooms.description: Suite with separate bedroom and living area.

rooms.name: Two Bedroom Suite
rooms.description: Two-bedroom suite sleeping up to six, ideal for families.

name: Peppers Soul Surfers Paradise
description: Peppers Soul Surfers Paradise is a 77-level luxury apartment tower at 8 The Esplanade, directly on the Surfers Paradise foreshore. Apartments have full kitchens, and there is a heated beach-view pool, a spa, sauna, steam room and gym. A stylish beachfront base for a Gold Coast holiday.

rooms.name: One Bedroom Apartment
rooms.description: Apartment with kitchen, balcony and ocean views.

rooms.name: Two Bedroom Apartment
rooms.description: Larger apartment with two bedrooms and full kitchen.

rooms.name: Sky View Apartment
rooms.description: High-floor apartment with panoramic coastline views.
